Chiko seed preview uses Cubiomes, Copyright (c) 2020 Cubitect,
with version/biome-tree patches from SeedForge contributors.
Original MIT license texts are distributed beside this file.

Sources are pinned in manifest.json and build_seed_generator.py:
https://github.com/Cubitect/cubiomes
https://github.com/fwsoapy/seedforge

The current adapter uses only Overworld biome prediction. Mapping Bedrock
26.50-26.52 to the patched MC_26_3 climate generator is experimental.
No Bedrock structure prediction or exact surface height is provided.
The local capture comparison does not establish compatibility for every biome,
height, historical generator version, or world. Keep real surfaces authoritative.

The DLL is built from source locally. Zig is a temporary build dependency,
not bundled or required to run the resulting preview.
